import sys
from collections import deque

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    if n > m:
        n, m = m, n
    V = n * m

    if V < 100:
        v = V
        g = [[] for _ in range(v)]
        for i in range(v):
            r1 = i // m
            c1 = i % m
            if ((r1 + c1) & 1) == 0:
                for j in range(v):
                    r2 = j // m
                    c2 = j % m
                    if abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - c2) == 3:
                        g[i].append(j)
        matching = hopcroft_karp(g, m)
        print(matching * 2)
    else:
        if n == 1:
            res = (m // 6) * 6
            if m % 6 == 4:
                res += 2
            elif m % 6 == 5:
                res += 4
        else:
            res = V
            if res % 2 == 1:
                res -= 1
        print(res)

def hopcroft_karp(g, cols):
    n = len(g)
    pairU = [-1] * n
    pairV = [-1] * n
    dist = [0] * n
    INF = 10**9
    matching = 0

    while bfs(g, cols, pairU, pairV, dist, INF):
        for u in range(n):
            r = u // cols
            c = u % cols
            if ((r + c) & 1) == 0 and pairU[u] == -1:
                if dfs(u, g, pairU, pairV, dist, INF):
                    matching += 1
    return matching

def bfs(g, cols, pairU, pairV, dist, INF):
    q = deque()
    for u in range(len(g)):
        r = u // cols
        c = u % cols
        if ((r + c) & 1) == 0 and pairU[u] == -1:
            dist[u] = 0
            q.append(u)
        else:
            dist[u] = INF
    found = False
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        for v in g[u]:
            if pairV[v] == -1:
                found = True
            elif dist[pairV[v]] == INF:
                dist[pairV[v]] = dist[u] + 1
                q.append(pairV[v])
    return found

def dfs(u, g, pairU, pairV, dist, INF):
    for v in g[u]:
        if pairV[v] == -1 or (dist[pairV[v]] == dist[u] + 1 and dfs(pairV[v], g, pairU, pairV, dist, INF)):
            pairU[u] = v
            pairV[v] = u
            return True
    dist[u] = INF
    return False

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
